title: Doctors and Teachers in Small Villages
grammar: Contrasting Centre and Periphery: míg ... addig
goal: I can describe differences in health care and school provision between a city and a small village.
I can contrast the two with *míg ..., addig ...* and *egyfelől ..., másfelől ...*.
I can attribute a diagnosis to the researchers who made it.
